My base case assumes GTA VI reaches an $8–12B run-rate (vs GTA V's ~$5–7B peak). That is **~1.5–1.8× the GTA V base rate.** Justifications for the deviation:
1. Higher price point ($79.99/$99.99 vs $59.99 for GTA V) [Actual].
2. PC + next-gen console + longer online lifecycle [Actual lineup].
3. "Unprecedented" pre-orders (Zelnick, no figures) [Actual, qualitative].

Step 1.5-3. Base-rate shock check:
